review_note: Retain the clinic’s practical tone, ethics questions, deadpan reminder and submission dates. Avoid assuming every student has eleven entries already or treating route selection as a predicted pattern.

edits.before: | 0:00--0:10 | **Choose a route.** Read back through your journal. Which entries keep returning to the same subroutine? That's often an experiment. Which keep returning to a cost? That's often a document. Tell a tutor your choice. |
